```artifact
Feature: Embedded Controller

  Scenario: Controller responds fast enough to prevent pressure dropping below -4cm
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When the pressure drops below -4cm
    Then the controller responds within 1 second to prevent pressure drop

  Scenario: Controller never commands pressure above 60
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When the commanded pressure is above 60
    Then the controller rejects the command

  Scenario: SW measures PEEP over each breath
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When a breath is completed
    Then the PEEP is measured and recorded

  Scenario: Controller hits commanded values within 10%
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When a parameter is commanded
    Then the actual value is within 10% of the commanded value

  Scenario: Controller triggers inspiration cycle
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When the inspiratory pressure is reached
    Then the controller triggers an inspiration cycle

  Scenario: Controller triggers expiration cycle
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When the expiratory pressure is reached
    Then the controller triggers an expiration cycle

  Scenario: Controller meets PIP targets in range 5-55cmH2O +/- 5cm
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When a PIP target is set
    Then the actual PIP is within 5cm of the target

  Scenario: Controller meets commanded breath rate within +- 1 breath
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When a breath rate is commanded
    Then the actual breath rate is within 1 breath of the commanded rate

  Scenario Outline: Controller responds to pressure changes
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When the pressure is changed to <pressure>
    Then the controller responds accordingly
    Examples:
      | pressure  |
      | -3.9cm    |
      | -4cm      |
      | 59.9cm    |
      | 60cm      |

  Scenario Outline: Controller responds to PIP targets
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When the PIP target is set to <target>
    Then the actual PIP is within 5cm of the target
    Examples:
      | target  |
      | 5cmH2O  |
      | 55cmH2O |
      | 0cmH2O  |

  Scenario Outline: Controller responds to breath rate commands
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    When the breath rate is commanded to <rate>
    Then the actual breath rate is within 1 breath of the commanded rate
    Examples:
      | rate  |
      | 10 breaths/min |
      | 100 breaths/min |
      | 0 breaths/min  |
```
